payload.title: Atmospheric Data: Nino 3 SST Index
payload.description: This notebook analyzes the Nino 3 Sea Surface Temperature (SST) Index using wavelet analysis to generate power and phase spectra. It involves downloading and organizing SST data, applying wavelet transforms, and visualizing the results.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for accessing data, working with arrays and dataframes, and plotting.
steps.title: Imports

steps.description: Download the Nino 3 SST data from geocat-datafiles.
steps.title: Download Nino 3 SST Data

steps.description: Visualize the downloaded SST data to understand its structure and content.
steps.title: Plot and View Data

steps.description: Convert the default X-axis from time steps to actual years for better readability.
steps.title: Update the X-Axis

steps.description: Define the input values required for wavelet analysis, including sampling period and scale parameters.
steps.title: Wavelet Input Values

steps.description: Define complex Morlet wavelets with different bandwidths and center frequencies for analysis.
steps.title: Define Complex Morlet

steps.description: Apply the wavelet transform to the SST data using the defined wavelets.
steps.title: Applying Wavelets

steps.description: Calculate and plot the power spectrum from the wavelet coefficients.
steps.title: Power Spectrum

steps.title: Phase Spectrum
